in_sanskrit.name: Mohibul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Beloved by All
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mohibul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mohibul is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mohit’, which means ‘to enchant’. The name signifies being beloved by all, as if one is under the spell of love from everyone. It is a powerful name that symbolizes charm, allure, and popularity.
